title: 1.1.2. Hetuvārādiuddesa
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te kusalahetū …pe… kusalanidānā …pe… kusalasambhavā …pe… kusalappabhavā …pe… kusalasamuṭṭhānā …pe… kusalāhārā …pe… kusalārammaṇā …pe… kusalapaccayā …pe… kusalasamudayā …pe….
Mūlaṁ hetu nidānañca, Sambhavo pabhavena ca; Samuṭṭhānāhārārammaṇā, Paccayo samudayena cāti.
